# ona_service_account (Resource)

Manages a service account, the non-human identity automation authenticates as. Tokens are not managed by this resource; create them in the Ona UI or through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ona_service_account" "ci" {
  name        = "ci"
  description = "Runs Terraform from CI"
  valid_until = "2027-01-31T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service account name. The API accepts 1 to 64 characters.
- `valid_until` (String) Expiry timestamp (RFC3339). Authentication fails after it passes. The API requires an expiry. Immutable: changing it replaces the service account.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Service account description. The API accepts at most 500 characters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the service account was created (RFC3339).
- `creator_id` (String) ID of the subject that created the service account.
- `creator_principal` (String) Principal type of the creator.
- `id` (String) Service account ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID the service account belongs to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ona_service_account.ci <service-account-id>
```
